description: Golden-answer tripwire (LAB-08): exact answers every working chat install should give. A failure on a new family is a finding to read, not proof of a bug on its own.

cases.prompt: What is 17 multiplied by 23? Reply with the number only.
What is the capital city of France? Reply with one word.
Write the word apple backwards. Reply with the reversed word only.
What number comes next: 2, 4, 8, 16? Reply with the number only.
What is the opposite of hot? Reply with one word.
Which month comes directly after February? Reply with one word.
Repeat this code exactly and add nothing else: zebra-7431
Sam is taller than Ann. Ann is taller than Tom. Who is the shortest? Reply with the name only.
